text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Grrr...! The enemy is attacking from 
inside my head...!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
That's exactly it! Ugh... what a 
formidable bunch...!
choice_data_list_en: Do you have a headache, by any chance?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Nay! That alone must be avoided!
choice_data_list: トレーニングは控えておくか……
トレーニングは控えておこっか……
choice_data_list_en: Maybe we should hold off on training...
Maybe we should hold off on training...?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Suspending training... In other words, 
admitting defeat to a headache!
choice_data_list:
But we can't just keep training like 
this...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Do not rush! It is precisely at times like 
this that we must stay calm and devise a 
strategy to fend off the enemy's attack!
choice_data_list: でも、このままトレーニングをするわけには
choice_data_list_en: Still, we can't just keep training like this...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Mmmph...! The more I think, the more my 
opponent goes wild inside my head~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, No Reason continued to be plagued 
by headaches afterward.
